test_title: PYST 08: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the father of B', 

'A - B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B', and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

How is P related to T if 'P ÷ Q - R × S + T'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Mother
 Wife
 Brother
 
 

 

Given: P ÷ Q - R × S + T

It means: P is the Brother of Q, Q is the Mother of R, R is the Wife of S, and S is the Father of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46286abd0204e85be49277bb45b3cace6aeeda09dfc1d7b6cf1442ade895dc70.png] 

So, P is the Mother's Mother's Brother of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**
